A field workshop brings several small groups together to explore practical ways of caring for shared neighbourhood gardens.
The morning session introduces soil preparation and explains how volunteers can divide the seasonal planting work fairly.
The afternoon session covers watering schedules and the practical equipment needed to keep young plants healthy through summer.
Bring sturdy shoes and gardening gloves.
The indoor room provides a quiet space for planning and comparing sketches of the beds before work begins.
The outdoor team will demonstrate simple techniques and answer questions about maintaining paths and collecting fallen leaves safely.
Materials are supplied for every participant.
After the demonstrations everyone can compare notes and suggest useful topics for the next community workshop in autumn.
